# Requ syntax

> An open-source language for swimlane workflows and operating maps.

Requ uses one statement per line. Use the language guide to write valid source. Diagrams and source are readable without JavaScript. Requstory import/export is not available yet.

## Documentation
- [Playground](https://requstory.com/dev/): editor, diagnostics and SVG export.
- [Language guide](https://requstory.com/dev/guide.html): complete syntax and examples.
- [Plain-text language guide](https://requstory.com/dev/LANGUAGE.md)
- [Full LLM reference](https://requstory.com/dev/llms-full.txt): guide and all example source.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/3d7tech/requ-syntax)

- [Customer refund](https://requstory.com/dev/examples/customer-refund/): static SVG and complete Requ source.
- [Employee onboarding](https://requstory.com/dev/examples/employee-onboarding/): static SVG and complete Requ source.
- [Broken example](https://requstory.com/dev/examples/errors-demo/): static SVG and complete Requ source.
- [Invoice approval](https://requstory.com/dev/examples/invoice-approval-with-agent/): static SVG and complete Requ source.
- [Retail loan application](https://requstory.com/dev/examples/loan-application/): static SVG and complete Requ source.
- [Northbank Retail](https://requstory.com/dev/examples/northbank-org/): static SVG and complete Requ source.
- [Example SaaS company](https://requstory.com/dev/examples/saas-company-org/): static SVG and complete Requ source.
